Verses.Text: For God did not make death, nor does he rejoice in the destruction of the living.
For he fashioned all things that they might have being.
The souls of the just are in the hand of God, and no torment shall touch them.
They seemed, in the view of the foolish, to be dead; and their passing away was thought an affliction and their going forth from us, utter destruction. But they are in peace.
For she is the refulgence of eternal light, the spotless mirror of the power of God, the image of his goodness.
God of my ancestors, Lord of mercy, you who have made all things by your word and in your wisdom have established humankind
Or who ever knew your counsel, except you had given Wisdom and sent your holy spirit from on high?
